page.content:
Caesar's lieutenant who split the east with Cleopatra and lost Actium.

How Mark Antony connects

  • Character: Augustus — Octavian defeated Antony at Actium.
  • Character: Julius Caesar — Antony was Caesar's lieutenant and avenger.

What is Mark Antony?

Marcus Antonius avenged Caesar, formed the Second Triumvirate, and ruled the east until Octavian's propaganda and Agrippa's fleet ended him in 31–30 BCE.

Key threads lead to Augustus and Julius Caesar.
